Endorsed Verified Partners - AICE - Association of International Credential Evaluators. Inc.
Endorsed Members
AICE’s Endorsed Member evaluation services must complete a
rigorous screening process
and follow stringent guidelines set forth in AICE’s Standards when providing credential evaluations. If you are in need of credential evaluation services, please contact one of our members listed below.
Rigorous Standards
Below are a few examples of some of the criteria our Endorsed Members must meet before being allowed to join AICE.
The agency underwent a thorough, independent/peer-reviewed site visit
Senior evaluators have a minimum five years of experience
Contribute to industry-respected conferences and research projects
Develops and adheres to education equivalency standards
Adhere to AACRAO EDGE standards
Adhere to International Education Standards Council (IESC) standards

Endorsed Member Screening Process
There is a rigorous screening process to join AICE Endorsed Membership so please thoroughly review
these membership requirements
before requesting an application for Endorsed Membership.
Endorsed Membership Definition
The Endorsed  Member category is open to organizations whose primary purpose and mission is to provide credential evaluation services to U.S. institutions, regulatory boards, HR departments, and other entities. Membership is contingent on the review, screening and verification of a candidate’s application, which includes preparation and submission of required documentation, interview and a site visit.
Benefits
The primary benefit of membership in AICE at any level is participation in the AICE Credential Evaluations Standards. AICE standards-based reports provide the user with a clearly written and formatted report that conforms to the highest standards of consistency, accuracy, comparability, transparency, portability and reliability in the field of international credential evaluations. All AICE members experience the added value of participating in the discussion and development of the AICE credential evaluation standards that promote consistently readable and understandable evaluation reports. Endorsed Members in AICE are authorized to attach the document that outlines AICE Credential Evaluation Standards to the evaluation reports which they produce.
Additional benefits and responsibilities of AICE Endorsed Membership include:
• Inclusion on the official list of Endorsed Members (for publicity);
• Use of the AICE name and logo on websites and promotional materials;
• Attendance at annual and quarterly business meetings;
• Representation and participation for individuals within the Endorsed Member organization;
• Eligibility to serve on committees and potentially on the Board of Directors;
• Voting privileges (one vote per Endorsed Member organization);
• Access to a network of members for professional collaboration;
• Opportunities to help shape credential evaluation standards;
• Attendance at and contributions to the AICE Monthly Credential Forum;
• Participation in joint research and publication initiatives;
• Eligibility to serve as an AICE consultant.
Membership is from January 1-December 31 and renewed at the end of each calendar year.
If you are interested in Endorsed Membership, email AICE at membership@aice-eval.org.  The application deadline for Endorsed Membership in AICE is September 15th of the current year.
